title: Theo and the Extraction
author: Sable Oyelaran
blurb: Juniper Whitlock, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
